eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this a
fter a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.\n116:- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts
into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes b
ack under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n117:- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n1
18:- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suit
e. Past runs that executed it are not affected.\n119:- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/updat
e-an-eval-case.md): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather
than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.\n12
0:- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact referen
ced by an ingested run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then referen
ce. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.\n121:- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` wi
th `code: \"FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run art
ifact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the `storageId` the run's results…
\n122:- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticate
d-eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the sa
me tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n123:- [Persist advisory case-run evalu
ations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run evalu
ations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities rem
ain absent.\n124:- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-ev
al-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK
reporter uses by default.\n125:- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/
mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hoste
d inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically
an `sk_` key).\n126:- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this
caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately — the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that
moment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than somethi
ng a caller must do.\n127:- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-
run.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.\n128:- [Append
